subject: SIG intake: scheduling call, agenda, and question triage
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scalehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Security intake / SIG kickoff - availability?

Hi David / Marissa / Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. ScaleHealth is starting an internal evaluation and we'd like to kick off a SIG/CAIQ intake to get the ball rolling. Primary goals for the call: 1) walk through the SIG/CAIQ scope, 2)confirm evidence owners and timelines, and 3) review any quick demo or logs we might need to validate integrations (SSO, data flows).

Can you share 30–45 minute windows in the next 3 business days? We're PST-based but flexible. Also, can you confirm who will own the CAIQ responses and who we should send technical log/sample requests to?

Attachments: none yet on our side — we can share SSO metadata if useful.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security
ScaleHealth

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scalehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security intake / SIG kickoff - availability?

Hi Liam — thanks for reaching out, happy to get this scheduled.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2026-12-14 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2026-12-14 15:00–15:45
- Wed 2026-12-15 09:30–10:15

We typically run a short agenda: introductions (5 min), scope/CAIQ & SIG touchpoints (15–20 min), evidence owner assignments and next steps (10–15 min), open Q&A (5–10 min). If you'd like a short demo of our logging/SSO flow we can add 10 min.

Marissa will be our CAIQ/sig lead and Mina will be the technical evidence owner for logs and retention samples. I'll coordinate follow-ups and the mutual action plan (MAP).

I'm attaching a draft CAIQ answer template and a short intake checklist to make the call more efficient. If you have SSO metadata you can send it prior to the call — that helps our engineers validate against your IdP quickly.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_CAIQ_questions.pdf (CAIQ preview), intake_checklist.md

—
David Kim
Account Director, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scalehealth.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 19:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security intake / SIG kickoff - availability?

Thanks, David and Liam. Quick agenda addendum and prep notes below — copied into the calendar invite pending time confirmation.

Proposed agenda (final):
- 0:00–0:05 — Introductions & objectives (ScaleHealth / Redwood)
- 0:05–0:20 — SIG vs CAIQ scope and what answers mean in practice
- 0:20–0:35 — Evidence review: logging samples, retention, encryption keys, SSO metadata
- 0:35–0:40 — Ownership & timeline (who provides what by when)
- 0:40–0:45 — Next steps / MAP & handoffs

Prep materials requested from ScaleHealth:
- SSO metadata (IdP XML or metadata URL)
- Any compliance controls you specifically want us to prioritize for CAIQ (e.g., data residency, admin access, PKI)

Note on CAIQ ownership: I'll draft answers for the policy/process sections and will ask the platform/infra teams for specific technical artifacts. Mina — can you confirm if you are comfortable owning log extracts + kube/instance-level retention samples? If not, we should include infra on the call.

Attaching a rough CAIQ answers draft (PDF) and a short evidence owner matrix for discussion.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_CAIQ_answers_draft_v1.pdf, evidence_owner_matrix.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scalehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 21:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security intake / SIG kickoff - availability?

Marissa — I can own the log/sample side. Quick notes on evidence we'll likely provide and any asks for ScaleHealth:

- What we'll provide: syslog slices (redacted), application access logs, token rotation records, and a short example of our KV cache lifecycle for inference requests. Retention windows (default): 30 days token-level traces, 90 days aggregated logs.
- What we need from ScaleHealth: expected retention window they require, example test requests (to reproduce relevant flows), and SSO metadata to validate assertion/attributes.
- If ScaleHealth needs longer retention or raw access logs, we should flag that as a potential enterprise config and timeline delta.

I've drafted a short "log_sample_instructions.md" that describes how we'll accept samples and redaction guidance — attaching it here. I'll also include a note in the calendar invite pointing to our secure upload folder.

Attachments: log_sample_instructions.md

—
Mina Haddad
SOC2 Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@scalehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security intake / SIG kickoff - availability?

Thanks all — we can do Tue 2026-12-14 10:00–10:45 PST. Calendar invite sent (see link).

I've attached our SSO metadata export (ScaleHealth_SSO_metadata.xml) and included a short MAP draft (DocuSign link below) which covers timelines and deliverables. We prioritize data residency and admin access controls for CAIQ.

DocuSign MAP: https://docusign.com/MAP/scalehealth-redwood/4532

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Liam
Head of Security, ScaleHealth
